summary.zh: 在 DSH Go 内置的 Ubuntu 环境里安装 magpie，默认起网关 + 网页版；面板里看状态、切换启动方式、配置网关/网页端口与安装代理，安装输出实时进日志。
summary.en: Installs magpie inside DSH Go's built-in Ubuntu environment and runs the gateway plus web console by default; a native panel shows status, start mode, ports and the install proxy, with live install logs.
